reviews.title: Repetitive storyline
reviews.text:
The stories on VibeShort are starting to feel like the same recycled plot: poor me, I married a mafia man, nobody believes me, everyone slaps me, and then the mafia guy swoops in as Captain Save-a-Hoe for the hundredth time. It’s boring, predictable, and full of helpless women waiting to be rescued.

Why is there so little ethnic diversity? And why does every story have to be a damsel-in-distress scenario? The production is inconsistent, too. Scenes don’t flow together, outfits and jewelry change between shots, rings end up on the wrong fingers, and the characters’ voices can change completely. How does an Italian mafia king suddenly have an English accent? Come on.

VibeShort needs more original stories, more diverse characters, stronger female leads, and better attention to continuity. Right now, these stories are repetitive and hard to take seriously.

reviews.title: Cheated!!! 😡😡😡
reviews.text:
The stories are okay. The storylines are definitely corny 😂, but they’re entertaining and fun enough to keep watching.

My issue isn’t even having to watch videos to earn credits to unlock more stories. If I’m choosing not to pay for the app, I don’t mind watching an ad in exchange for credits. That seems fair.

The problem is that A LOT of the time, I’ll watch the entire required video and then get an error afterward—or I simply won’t receive the credit I was supposed to earn. Then I’m expected to watch another video and hope it works the next time.

If this happened once or twice, I’d assume it was just a system glitch. But it happens way too often for me to believe that anymore. At this point, it honestly feels intentional. If users are required to watch an advertisement to earn credits, then the credits should be awarded once the ad has been watched. You shouldn’t get the benefit of someone watching the entire ad and then not give them the reward that was promised.

The stories are corny but fun. The ad/credit system is what makes the app frustrating.

reviews.title: Cannot Cancel Subscription – Support Ignores Requests
reviews.text:
The app’s subscription system is very concerning. It advertises that subscriptions can be cancelled at any time, but in practice this is not the case. I submitted a cancellation request before renewal and provided my UID and screenshots showing an active “Weekly Pass Pro” subscription. 
Support failed to act and repeatedly sent automated responses claiming they could not find my account, despite the details being taken directly from the app. No meaningful assistance was provided, and auto-renewal was not clearly disabled. 
This creates a serious risk of unwanted recurring charges and suggests poor or misleading support processes. I would strongly caution users before subscribing, as cancelling may not be straightforward.

reviews.title: Good stories, deceptive subscription
reviews.text:
The stories are well thought out and interesting, however, do not attempt to subscribe to ANY paid plan. Subscriptions and payments are processed via a third party website, which will then charge to your card without appearing under Apple subscriptions. You are unable to cancel in the app, via wallet, or even via your settings app. They offer a customer support email, which will usually be an automated reply and not cancel your subscription for you. Please do a quick search on Google, reddit, or any review site before purchasing anything from this app. You are essentially unable to cancel your subscription without going through hours worth of credit card disputes and email hassle.

If you opt for the free version, this can be a fun entertainment app with lots of fantasy options. Otherwise, look elsewhere.

Customer support is no help. In my case, I never received a response. My friend did receive a reply, but was told that even with their UID, the company couldn’t locate the account. We both ultimately had to cancel our bank cards just to stop the recurring charges.

To make matters worse, the content available on this app can easily be found on other platforms. I strongly recommend looking elsewhere. Based on my experience, this app feels very misleading and just a scheme to make money. The developer appears to respond to similar complaints with the same generic response, while the underlying issues remain unresolved.

I wish I had done more research before downloading this app. A quick internet search would have shown that many other users have experienced the same problems and would have saved me a significant amount of frustration.

Please learn from my mistake and avoid this app.

I was charged and I can see the subscription when I check under settings in my phone but all episodes were not unlocked like promised.  Restore function says there is nothing to restore and when I try to buy again it simply says I have already purchased and can only “manage” subscription.  This then takes me to my settings app under subscription with about 25 different options to choose from that make no sense.  I have to email a bunch of stuff to even get my money back so they don’t even make that process easy for the user.  Try harder.  What a  complete and utter waste of time and money.

reviews.title: Such a bummer.
reviews.text:
Please be careful when getting this app. I only saw this one ad on TikTok and got hooked, so I got the app. It was just 3.99 for the weekly pass trial, so I got it. You can’t even cancel the subscription on Apple. I realized that the very second I paid. I’ve been trying to get in contact with their services. At first, they were cooperating; however, they kept repeating that they couldn’t find my email, even though the app is already connected to it. I continuously kept sending in the ID from the app, but nothing. 

Eventually, I guess they gave up, sending me back to the same old place over and over again with what they could help me with, until finally they just stopped responding. It’s frustrating, I’ve been trying to fix this problem for 3 hours now, and there's been no progress. Please don't do the same mistake as me when downloading this app. And I really wish they could add ways for me to cancel this subscription myself on the app store. 

If anyone can, please help me with this problem of mine immediately!! I don't want to pay for anything else from this app!

reviews.title: Poor translations, poor language, 0 endings, repetitive stories
reviews.text:
I joined because of about 4ads I saw on TikTok, whose stories I wanted to continue. Particularly the one about beast ward academy. The story was not only incomplete, it was 15 episodes only, with half of that behind a subscription. I found another show that I wanted to watch, which was also very short, but at least it was 50 episodes. However, after finishing it, I realised that there is another show, under a different name with exactly the same script and even names, just different art style. So it’s just a bunch of same stories, but you pay the same as any other app. 

My other problems was the inconsistent language. The name Selene, for example, was pronounced at least in 7-8 different ways in one show, which made it difficult to follow who or what the story is about. In another show, the one’s about wolves, not only did the name changed multiple times, so did the character’s art or even referencing (talking about someone else instead it themselves).

I think you think it’s easy money using AI to create these bs, but if it’s difficult to follow the stories, there’s no story and no one will be interested. It’s so confusing, it’s no longer relaxing to watch. So I am cancelling my subscription after this. It’s a pity. You had a few good storyline’s.

reviews.title: Impossible to Cancel & Feels Misleading Extremely Frustrating Experience
reviews.text:
I rarely leave reviews, but my experience with VibeShort has been incredibly frustrating. Trying to cancel my subscription has been a nightmare. The instructions they provide don’t match what actually appears in the app, and if you subscribed through a browser, it becomes even more confusing and difficult.

On top of that, their website has been unreliable or completely unavailable when I needed it most. I reached out to support and instead of a clear, helpful resolution, I felt like I was being stalled while my billing cycle continued.

This whole experience feels misleading and poorly managed. Canceling a subscription shouldn’t be this complicated. I would not recommend this app to anyone unless they improve their customer service and make cancellation straightforward and transparent.
